title: Terminal V to inaugurate new open-air venue in Scotland
summary: Leading Scottish electronic festival Terminal V will step up its offerings for its 10th edition in 2027, scaling to three days and moving locations to Glasgow’s new Clydeside Live outdoor venue. The EE Live-produced event is set to take place from 4-6 June 2027, and will be the festival’s first fully outdoor Scottish event. It will be staged in Glasgow’s historic docklands, with Terminal V to be the first festival held at the city’s new open-air event site.
